features: 【Transparent Curved】The wireless keyboard is ergonomically designed for ease of use, featuring a curved design. Its base offers high transparency and is heat-resistant, impact-resistant, and flame-retardant.

【Multi Devices】The keyboard supports multiple devices and operating systems, seamlessly switching between three devices using Bluetooth technology. It automatically detects different operating systems and layouts, and is compatible with Windows PCs/Laptops, iMacs/MacBooks, iPhones/iPads, and Android smartphones/tablets.
【Non Slip Efficient】Designed with a standard numeric keypad, mute option, and a non-slip base, this keyboard features essential keys that enhance your workflow and productivity.

【Responsive & Low-profile】The scissor key mechanism improves feedback and stability, while the optimized key travel and anti-slip tapes ensure a more comfortable, quiet, and precise typing experience.

【USB Type C Rechargeable】The keyboard features a built-in rechargeable battery that can be charged via Type-C. After just 2 hours of charging, it provides up to 45 days of use. The power-saving mode automatically puts the keyboard to sleep when inactive.
